10.1.1. Traded Securities265
(a) A money market or debt security shall be considered as traded

10.1.2. Thinly Traded equity/ equity related securities:266

convertible debentures, equity warrants etc.) in a month is both
less than Rs. 5 lakhs and the total volume (i.e. trades on all
